result.rationale: Across turns 1-5, the rescue team repeatedly issues guard::command-deck intents that resolve as "no_effect" (no_hostile_movement_triggered) while the swarm/pirate actors repeatedly fail with "target_zone_capacity_lost" contestation. The team never leaves command-deck after turn 0, never makes contact with hive-alpha, and never progresses any objective. The dominant pattern is repeated low-information failure: the same guard actions produce no new information or progress, and the same contested moves recur turn after turn. The reactor-heat climbs monotonically to 100 and battery/oxygen drain, yet no new knowledge or route is gained after turn 0. This is the narrowest causal target — the repeated failure loop itself is the bottleneck, not a specific route or mechanic.
